title:
Either individual test cases or an entire test suite can be ignored in the markdown.

Test cases can be ignored in the Markdown by "x"ing the code blocks. For example, if a block tests functionality
not implemented yet, the test can be ignored on the opening fenced code block line: "```x:PLAT-12345". The "x"
indicates the test is ignored and indicates the associated ticket.

It is also possible to specify one or more actionRequirement/ticket pairs, in which case it is only ignored for that
actionRequirement: "```x:py PLAT-12345" specifies that the test is only ignored in Python. If multiple or more specific
actionRequirements are needed, they can be specified as well: "```x:py-jep PLAT-12345, java PLAT-67890".

To ignore the entire test suite, the first Markdown paragraph should contain a single line that follows the same
"x"ing syntax as for an individual test case.

@see ImplLanguage
name: TestSuite.Ignore
